items.quote: I got into an accident and ruined my right front tire, tie rod, swaybar and lower control arm. I called Mike, and he was understanding, informed and fast.
I had one of my diesel trucks go down in my truck yard on a Wednesday morning. I called Mike's mobile and he came out within the hour and everything was repaired quickly and accurately.
We tried 3 other mechanics, Mike answered his phone and gave us a 2 hour ETA. He got to us with our new part already in hand.
